stem: Solve $x^3-x^2-16x-20=0$. Tap every solution on the number line.
solution: Set each factor to zero: $x=5$ and $x=-2$ (repeated, marked once).

hints.text: Factorise the quadratic part fully, then set each distinct factor to zero.
Substitute each marked value into $P(x)$; only values giving $0$ are solutions.
Set each factor equal to zero and solve it: a factor $(x+a)$ gives $x=-a$.
